purpose: This table holds cleaned 2013 NYC-area flight operations records (scheduled and actual departure/arrival times, delays, carrier, routing, and distance) for one flight per carrier per day, feeding downstream analytics on flight delay and on-time performance.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum as nullable and filter or branch on nulls explicitly rather than assuming every flight completed; dep_time/sched_dep_time/arr_time/sched_arr_time remain integer HHMM encodings (e.g. 1455 means 14:55), not true time types, so callers must parse them accordingly, while time_hour is a proper TIMESTAMP suitable for time-series joins.
limitations: Roughly 3% of rows are missing actual departure and arrival times, delays, and air_time (null_rate 0.029388-0.032981), most plausibly cancelled or diverted flights, and these nulls are retained rather than resolved; tailnum is missing for about 0.9% of rows (null_rate 0.009154); the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight) was not verified for uniqueness in the warehouse and should be checked before relying on it as a primary key.
